body:
Hi @michalszynkiewicz,

Thanks for your response, 
i have simplified  by including LocalOctetResource instead of mockoon, so to replicate the issue:

1. git pull
2. start quarkus
3. Execute curl that will fail
```
curl --location --request GET 'http://localhost:9084/header/with-reactive-headers' \
--header 'Accept: application/json'
```
4. Execute curl that will work
```
curl --location --request GET 'http://localhost:9084/header/without-reactive-headers' \
--header 'Accept: application/json'
```

wireshark suggests it's actually headers from the initiating call that get passed, ~~weird, I'll continue looking into it~~
Well, not weird at all, your factory takes the incoming headers and adds the token header to it.

But! Even if I change the factory to not propagate the incoming headers, it still does it. That's probably a bug.

issue.title: Make ReactiveClientHeadersFactory replace headers instead of adding
